usage: harness [-h]
               {plan,peek,quiet,wake,work,plan-fetch,deliver,event,sweep,status,dashboard,stats,halt,start,dispatch,providers,window,doctor,setup,triage,forget} ...

The command line: `harness <command>` from the `bot/` directory. The workflows
call `peek`, `quiet`, `plan`, `work`, `deliver`, `event` and `sweep`. An
operator calls `status`, `providers`, `halt`, `start`, `dispatch`, `doctor`,
`setup` and `forget`, with a token in BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN or
GH_TOKEN, or a logged-in `gh`.

positional arguments:
  {plan,peek,quiet,wake,work,plan-fetch,deliver,event,sweep,status,dashboard,stats,halt,start,dispatch,providers,window,doctor,setup,triage,forget}
    plan                decide what this night run does, and claim it
    peek                would a run find work? changes nothing
    quiet               wait until nobody else is spending the subscription
    wake                start the Claude sessions that are not running
                        (wake.py)
    work                the model job: build, review and fix one item
    plan-fetch          read the plan the status loop made for this run
                        (#1455)
    deliver             check the model job's output and publish it
    event               handle one GitHub event
    sweep               answer any request an event handler never answered
    status              print the status report
    dashboard           rewrite the pinned status issue (bot-status runs it
                        every five minutes, its runners every two)
    stats               rewrite the pinned status issue now, with its
                        statistics
    halt                stop all model work
    start               lift a halt
    dispatch            start a night run now
    providers           each subscription's hours, limits and readiness
    window              each subscription's hours, limits and readiness
    doctor              check the configuration and the repository
    setup               create or update the labels, and create the state
                        branch
    triage              label, type and assign a new issue or pull request, an
                        issue labelled human, or one a person called it on
    forget              clear an item's failure count

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: harness dashboard [-h] [--every EVERY] [--runners-every RUNNERS_EVERY]
                         [--for FOR_SECONDS] [--sweep] [--stats]
                         [--companions] [--controller] [--section-only]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --every EVERY         seconds between rewrites; 0 rewrites it once
  --runners-every RUNNERS_EVERY
                        seconds between redraws of the runners section alone,
                        between the rewrites; 0 draws it only with them
  --for FOR_SECONDS     how long to keep rewriting it, in seconds
  --sweep               sweep before each rewrite, as the ten-minute sweep
                        does
  --stats               carry the statistics in it, counted afresh every 30
                        minutes
  --companions          also sweep and draw each other bot (Squishy) in a
                        process of its own, and put its section in the issue
  --controller          with the config's `controller` on, plan the work and
                        start each night run with its plan in the sweep
                        (#1455)
  --section-only        print this bot's section of the status issue and write
                        nothing (the night bot's loop runs this as Squishy)

usage: harness stats [-h] [--force] [--companions] [--section-only]

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --force         count the statistics afresh even if they were counted under
                  30 minutes ago
  --companions    also put in each other bot's section and record (Squishy's),
                  drawn by its own process
  --section-only  print this bot's record for the statistics and write nothing
